quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett
quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on defensive focus and reducing turnovers against the Clippers
quotes.excerpt: making sure that we're all of us are locked in from the jump.
quotes.quote: One, defensively, just making sure that we're all of us are locked in from the jump. And then at the same time, we can't turn over the ball. We had nine in the first quarter, that's tough. We had a better second and fourth quarter. I think third was okay, but we definitely had a better second and fourth quarter. We turned the ball over three times in the second half and you see how much better we played.
quotes.social_post: RJ Barrett highlights turnovers as a major issue for the Raptors. We had nine in the first quarter and that is tough. You see how much better we played when we protected the ball in the second half.

quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett
quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on simplifying the offense to avoid turnovers
quotes.excerpt: I think we're trying to start off aggressive, but at the same time, especially beginning of the game.
quotes.quote: I think we're trying to start off aggressive, but at the same time, especially beginning of the game, the defense is always really loaded up. So just being smart, I ran into Luka Doncic, got two charges. Just stuff like that, being smart. Sharing the ball and just waiting for things to open up so we can attack those gaps and get to what we want to get to.
quotes.social_post: RJ Barrett on how the Raptors can improve their offensive efficiency. We are trying to start off aggressive but we need to be smart. Sharing the ball and waiting for things to open up is key.
